title: Fluidstack signs 10-year, 200+ MW leases at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner (~$3.7B)

sources.quote: The agreements represent approximately $3.7 billion in contracted revenue over the initial 10-year terms and include two five-year extension options which, if exercised, would bring the total contract revenue to approximately $8.7 billion.

explain: Fluidstack, an AI cloud provider, will rent more than 200 megawatts at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner campus in New York for 10 years, worth about $3.7 billion. Google backstops part of Fluidstack's rent and received warrants for a stake in TeraWulf.
